steps.en: Add the package; it ships the Rust engine as a native addon (or WASM in the browser)
steps.zh: 装包，Rust 引擎随包以原生扩展（浏览器里是 WASM）带进来

steps.en: Open a database file — an existing SQLite file works as-is
steps.zh: 打开一个库文件，现成的 SQLite 文件原样可用

steps.en: Opens the SQLite-format file inside your process; no server, no socket
steps.zh: 在你的进程里直接打开 SQLite 格式文件，没有服务端、没有网络

steps.en: Write plain SQLite SQL through the binding
steps.zh: 照写 SQLite 方言的 SQL

steps.en: Compiles the SQL to VDBE bytecode and runs it, with async I/O underneath
steps.zh: 把 SQL 编译成 VDBE 字节码执行，底下走异步 I/O

value.en: An embedded SQLite-compatible database from JS, Python, Go, Java, .NET or Rust, in a file you can still hand back to sqlite3
value.zh: 各主流语言里嵌一个 SQLite 兼容库，不用起服务，文件仍能交回 sqlite3 打开

sources: https://github.com/tursodatabase/turso README (JavaScript section: npm i @tursodatabase/database, connect('sqlite.db'), db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users'); About: VDBE bytecode)
bindings/javascript/README.md and package.json (native + wasm packages, napi-rs)
COMPAT.md Guarantees (existing SQLite files readable; always able to go back to SQLite)
docs/manual.md Introduction (in-process engine, no network protocol)
